subject: physics
content: A Carnot freezer takes heat from water at 0<sup>o</sup>C inside it and rejects it to the room at a temperature of 27<sup>o</sup>C. The latent heat of ice is 336×10<sup>3</sup> J kg<sup>−1</sup>. If 5 kg of water at 0<sup>o</sup>C is converted into ice at 0<sup>o</sup>C by the freezer, then the energy consumed by the freezer is close to :
